options.content:
Sail systems

Sail-hydraulic PLC data from the sail-systems MQTT adapter. First the **loads and positions** per group (Head, Main, Mizzen, Winches) and the **Mast**, then the **status per function** and the **alarms** in the range, then the **details per function**, grouped the same way. Times are UTC. Loads in t, positions in %. The info icon of each panel says how to read it.

panels.title: Head · loads
panels.description: Load in t of each load the loads app shows. Average per interval. Legend: last value and max in the range; click a name to show only that line.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg("st_load/i_load") / 100.0 AS "Blade cunningham (F0101)"
FROM (SELECT timestamp, "st_load/i_load" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "st_load/i_load" FROM sail_systems__f0101_blade_cunningham WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "st_load/i_load" FROM sail_systems__f0101_blade_cunningham WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) s
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Configuration
panels.description: Each PLC setting at the start and end of the range, and its min and max in it; min and max differ when it changed. Raw PLC units (loads in daN, positions in mm).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT unnest(make_array('storm_sail_furler_load/i_max_load_setting')) AS setting,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."storm_sail_furler_load/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."storm_sail_furler_load/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE))) AS max
FROM (SELECT "storm_sail_furler_load/i_max_load_setting" FROM sail_systems__mast WHERE timestamp <= $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) s
FULL JOIN (SELECT "storm_sail_furler_load/i_max_load_setting" FROM sail_systems__mast WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true
CROSS JOIN (SELECT min("storm_sail_furler_load/i_max_load_setting") AS n0, max("storm_sail_furler_load/i_max_load_setting") AS x0 FROM sail_systems__mast WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) r

panels.title: Alarms active in the range
panels.description: General and load alarms set in the range: first and last time, and how often raised (a new run after more than 5 s without the alarm).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'F0101 Blade cunningham' AS function, alarm, min(first) AS first_active, max(last) AS last_active,
  sum(CASE WHEN prev IS NULL OR bin - prev > INTERVAL '5 seconds' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS raised
FROM (SELECT alarm, bin, first, last, LAG(bin) OVER (PARTITION BY alarm ORDER BY bin) AS prev

panels.title: Head · Blade Cunningham · F0101 Blade cunningham

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg("st_load/i_load") / 100.0 AS "blade-cunningham-load · st_load/i_load",
  min("st_load/i_load") / 100.0 AS "blade-cunningham-load · st_load/i_load min",
  max("st_load/i_load") / 100.0 AS "blade-cunningham-load · st_load/i_load max",
  max("st_load/i_max_load_setting") / 100.0 AS "st_load/i_max_load_setting"
FROM (SELECT timestamp, "st_load/i_load", "st_load/i_max_load_setting" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "st_load/i_load", "st_load/i_max_load_setting" FROM sail_systems__f0101_blade_cunningham WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "st_load/i_load", "st_load/i_max_load_setting" FROM sail_systems__f0101_blade_cunningham WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) s
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Commands and status
panels.description: Blue: command or PLC output (ox_) on, green: status true. Opposite commands such as pull/ease share a lane. x_on_off: HMI toggle, x_ext_on_off: AMCS toggle.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "x_in/out", c3 AS "x_cyl_a", c4 AS "x_cyl_b", c5 AS "x_ext_on_off", c6 AS "x_on_off", c7 AS "x_running", c8 AS "st_position_ps/x_can_alive", c9 AS "st_position_sb/x_can_alive", c10 AS "x_function_enabled", c11 AS "x_group_enabled", c12 AS "x_sensr_in", c13 AS "x_sensr_out" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13 FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_in") AND bool_or("x_out") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("x_in") THEN 'in' WHEN bool_or("x_out") THEN 'out' WHEN count("x_in") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    bool_or("x_cyl_a") AS c3,
    bool_or("x_cyl_b") AS c4,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c5,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c7,
    bool_or("st_position_ps/x_can_alive") AS c8,
    bool_or("st_position_sb/x_can_alive") AS c9,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c10,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c11,
    bool_or("x_sensr_in") AS c12,
    bool_or("x_sensr_out") AS c13
    FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_position_ps/x_can_alive", "st_position_sb/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_position_ps/x_can_alive", "st_position_sb/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0101_blade_cunningham WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_position_ps/x_can_alive", "st_position_sb/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0101_blade_cunningham WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR (c13 IS DISTINCT FROM p13)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Alarms
panels.description: Red: alarm active. CAN state: off, ok or fault. Alarm codes as numbers, 0 = none.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "ox_gnrl_alrm", c1 AS "ox_load_alarm", c2 AS "st_load/x_failure", c3 AS "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", c4 AS "st_position_ps/x_can_missing", c5 AS "st_position_ps/x_failure", c6 AS "st_position_ps/x_max_limit_reached", c7 AS "st_position_ps/x_min_limit_reached", c8 AS "st_position_sb/x_can_missing", c9 AS "st_position_sb/x_failure", c10 AS "st_position_sb/x_max_limit_reached", c11 AS "st_position_sb/x_min_limit_reached", c12 AS "st_position_ps/w_can_state", c13 AS "st_position_sb/w_can_state" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13 FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    bool_or("ox_gnrl_alrm") AS c0,
    bool_or("ox_load_alarm") AS c1,
    bool_or("st_load/x_failure") AS c2,
    bool_or("st_load/x_max_limit_reached") AS c3,
    bool_or("st_position_ps/x_can_missing") AS c4,
    bool_or("st_position_ps/x_failure") AS c5,
    bool_or("st_position_ps/x_max_limit_reached") AS c6,
    bool_or("st_position_ps/x_min_limit_reached") AS c7,
    bool_or("st_position_sb/x_can_missing") AS c8,
    bool_or("st_position_sb/x_failure") AS c9,
    bool_or("st_position_sb/x_max_limit_reached") AS c10,
    bool_or("st_position_sb/x_min_limit_reached") AS c11,

    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c11,
    bool_or("x_sensr_in") AS c12,

panels.title: Commands and status
panels.description: Blue: command or PLC output (ox_) on, green: status true. Opposite commands such as pull/ease share a lane. x_on_off: HMI toggle, x_ext_on_off: AMCS toggle.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "x_in/out", c3 AS "x_cyl_a", c4 AS "x_cyl_b", c5 AS "x_ext_on_off", c6 AS "x_on_off", c7 AS "x_running", c8 AS "x_function_enabled", c9 AS "x_group_enabled", c10 AS "x_sensr_in", c11 AS "x_sensr_out" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11 FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_in") AND bool_or("x_out") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("x_in") THEN 'in' WHEN bool_or("x_out") THEN 'out' WHEN count("x_in") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    bool_or("x_cyl_a") AS c3,
    bool_or("x_cyl_b") AS c4,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c5,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c7,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c8,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c9,
    bool_or("x_sensr_in") AS c10,
    bool_or("x_sensr_out") AS c11
    FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0103_blade_adjuster WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0103_blade_adjuster WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Alarms
panels.description: Red: alarm active. CAN state: off, ok or fault. Alarm codes as numbers, 0 = none.

targets.rawSql:

  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_failure", "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", "x_combined_load_alarm" FROM sail_systems__f0103_blade_adjuster WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7)

  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11 FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,

    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c5,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c6,

WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11)

panels.title: Configuration

targets.rawSql:
SELECT unnest(make_array('i_furl_speed_setting', 'i_unfurl_speed_setting')) AS setting,

    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,

    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_alive") AS c8,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_ready") AS c9,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_run") AS c10,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c11,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c12
    FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_low_torque", "ox_pull", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_low_torque", "ox_pull", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe202_blade_sheet_ps_feeder WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p

    GROUP BY 1

    FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "x_speed_deviation_alarm", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "x_speed_deviation_alarm", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM sail_systems__fe202_blade_sheet_ps_feeder WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p

  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, c15, c16, c17, c18, c19, c20, c21, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LAG(c14) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p14, LAG(c15) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p15, LAG(c16) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p16, LAG(c17) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p17, LAG(c18) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p18, LAG(c19) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p19, LAG(c20) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p20, LAG(c21) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p21 FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ox_pull") AND bool_or("ox_ease") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ox_pull") THEN 'pull' WHEN bool_or("ox_ease") THEN 'ease' WHEN count("ox_pull") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,

    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_alive") AS c15,

    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c18,

    bool_or("x_inner_limit") AS c20,
    bool_or("x_outer_limit") AS c21
    FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM sail_systems__fe301_blade_sheet_captive_winch_sb WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM sail_systems__fe301_blade_sheet_captive_winch_sb WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a

WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR (c13 IS DISTINCT FROM p13) OR (c14 IS DISTINCT FROM p14) OR (c15 IS DISTINCT FROM p15) OR (c16 IS DISTINCT FROM p16) OR (c17 IS DISTINCT FROM p17) OR (c18 IS DISTINCT FROM p18) OR (c19 IS DISTINCT FROM p19) OR (c20 IS DISTINCT FROM p20) OR (c21 IS DISTINCT FROM p21)

panels.description: Each PLC setting at the start and end of the range, and its min and max in it; min and max differ when it changed. Raw PLC units (loads in daN, positions in mm).

  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."i_set_actual_line_length" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_ease_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_line_tension_delay" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_pull_max_speed" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."i_set_actual_line_length" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_ease_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_line_tension_delay" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_pull_max_speed" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n6 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n7 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x6 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x7 AS DOUBLE))) AS max
FROM (SELECT "i_set_actual_line_length", "s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed", "s_settings/i_ease_max_speed", "s_settings/i_line_tension_delay", "s_settings/i_max_position", "s_settings/i_min_position", "s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed", "s_settings/i_pull_max_speed" FROM sail_systems__fe301_blade_sheet_captive_winch_sb WHERE timestamp <= $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) s
FULL JOIN (SELECT "i_set_actual_line_length", "s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed", "s_settings/i_ease_max_speed", "s_settings/i_line_tension_delay", "s_settings/i_max_position", "s_settings/i_min_position", "s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed", "s_settings/i_pull_max_speed" FROM sail_systems__fe301_blade_sheet_captive_winch_sb WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true
CROSS JOIN (SELECT min("i_set_actual_line_length") AS n0, max("i_set_actual_line_length") AS x0, min("s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed") AS n1, max("s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed") AS x1, min("s_settings/i_ease_max_speed") AS n2, max("s_settings/i_ease_max_speed") AS x2, min("s_settings/i_line_tension_delay") AS n3, max("s_settings/i_line_tension_delay") AS x3, min("s_settings/i_max_position") AS n4, max("s_settings/i_max_position") AS x4, min("s_settings/i_min_position") AS n5, max("s_settings/i_min_position") AS x5, min("s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed") AS n6, max("s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed") AS x6, min("s_settings/i_pull_max_speed") AS n7, max("s_settings/i_pull_max_speed") AS x7 FROM sail_systems__fe301_blade_sheet_captive_winch_sb WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) r

panels.title: Commands and status
panels.description: Blue: command or PLC output (ox_) on, green: status true. Opposite commands such as pull/ease share a lane. x_on_off: HMI toggle, x_ext_on_off: AMCS toggle.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "ox_low_torque", c3 AS "ox_pull", c4 AS "s_drive/x_running", c5 AS "x_ext_on_off", c6 AS "x_on_off", c7 AS "x_running", c8 AS "s_drive/x_can_alive", c9 AS "s_drive/x_ready", c10 AS "s_drive/x_run", c11 AS "x_function_enabled", c12 AS "x_group_enabled" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12 FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    bool_or("ox_low_torque") AS c2,
    bool_or("ox_pull") AS c3,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_running") AS c4,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c5,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c7,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_alive") AS c8,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_ready") AS c9,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_run") AS c10,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c11,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c12
    FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_low_torque", "ox_pull", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_low_torque", "ox_pull", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe204_staysail_sheet_ps_feeder WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_low_torque", "ox_pull", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe204_staysail_sheet_ps_feeder WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12)

    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_alive") AS c8,

    FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_low_torque", "ox_pull", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_low_torque", "ox_pull", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe304_staysail_sheet_sb_feeder WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p

panels.title: Commands and status
panels.description: Blue: command or PLC output (ox_) on, green: status true. Opposite commands such as pull/ease share a lane. x_on_off: HMI toggle, x_ext_on_off: AMCS toggle.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "x_in/out", c3 AS "x_cyl_a", c4 AS "x_cyl_b", c5 AS "x_ext_on_off", c6 AS "x_on_off", c7 AS "x_running", c8 AS "st_load_ps/x_can_alive", c9 AS "st_load_sb/x_can_alive", c10 AS "st_position/x_can_alive", c11 AS "x_function_enabled", c12 AS "x_group_enabled", c13 AS "x_sensr_in", c14 AS "x_sensr_out" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LAG(c14) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p14 FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_in") AND bool_or("x_out") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("x_in") THEN 'in' WHEN bool_or("x_out") THEN 'out' WHEN count("x_in") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    bool_or("x_cyl_a") AS c3,
    bool_or("x_cyl_b") AS c4,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c5,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c7,
    bool_or("st_load_ps/x_can_alive") AS c8,
    bool_or("st_load_sb/x_can_alive") AS c9,
    bool_or("st_position/x_can_alive") AS c10,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c11,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c12,
    bool_or("x_sensr_in") AS c13,
    bool_or("x_sensr_out") AS c14
    FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_load_ps/x_can_alive", "st_load_sb/x_can_alive", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_load_ps/x_can_alive", "st_load_sb/x_can_alive", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0203_main_checkstay_deflector WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_load_ps/x_can_alive", "st_load_sb/x_can_alive", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0203_main_checkstay_deflector WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR (c13 IS DISTINCT FROM p13) OR (c14 IS DISTINCT FROM p14)
ORDER BY time

SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg("st_load/i_load") / 100.0 AS "st_load/i_load",
  min("st_load/i_load") / 100.0 AS "st_load/i_load min",
  max("st_load/i_load") / 100.0 AS "st_load/i_load max",
  avg("st_load_lc/i_load") / 100.0 AS "main-preventer-load · st_load_lc/i_load",
  min("st_load_lc/i_load") / 100.0 AS "main-preventer-load · st_load_lc/i_load min",
  max("st_load_lc/i_load") / 100.0 AS "main-preventer-load · st_load_lc/i_load max",
  max("st_load/i_max_load_setting") / 100.0 AS "st_load/i_max_load_setting",
  max("st_load_lc/i_max_load_setting") / 100.0 AS "st_load_lc/i_max_load_setting"
FROM (SELECT timestamp, "st_load/i_load", "st_load_lc/i_load", "st_load/i_max_load_setting", "st_load_lc/i_max_load_setting" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "st_load/i_load", "st_load_lc/i_load", "st_load/i_max_load_setting", "st_load_lc/i_max_load_setting" FROM sail_systems__f0204_main_boom_preventer WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "st_load/i_load", "st_load_lc/i_load", "st_load/i_max_load_setting", "st_load_lc/i_max_load_setting" FROM sail_systems__f0204_main_boom_preventer WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) s
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "st_cylinder/x_in/out", c3 AS "x_in/out", c4 AS "st_cylinder/x_cyl_a", c5 AS "st_cylinder/x_cyl_b", c6 AS "st_cylinder/x_ext_on_off", c7 AS "st_cylinder/x_on_off", c8 AS "st_cylinder/x_running", c9 AS "x_cvlve", c10 AS "x_cyl_a", c11 AS "x_cyl_b", c12 AS "x_ext_on_off", c13 AS "x_on_off", c14 AS "x_running", c15 AS "st_cylinder/x_function_enabled", c16 AS "st_cylinder/x_group_enabled", c17 AS "st_cylinder/x_local_control", c18 AS "st_cylinder/x_maintenance", c19 AS "st_cylinder/x_rc_control", c20 AS "st_cylinder/x_sensr_in", c21 AS "st_cylinder/x_sensr_out", c22 AS "st_load_lc/x_can_alive", c23 AS "st_position/x_can_alive", c24 AS "x_function_enabled", c25 AS "x_group_enabled", c26 AS "x_sensr_in", c27 AS "x_sensr_out" FROM (

    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("st_cylinder/x_in") AND bool_or("st_cylinder/x_out") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("st_cylinder/x_in") THEN 'in' WHEN bool_or("st_cylinder/x_out") THEN 'out' WHEN count("st_cylinder/x_in") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_in") AND bool_or("x_out") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("x_in") THEN 'in' WHEN bool_or("x_out") THEN 'out' WHEN count("x_in") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c3,
    bool_or("st_cylinder/x_cyl_a") AS c4,
    bool_or("st_cylinder/x_cyl_b") AS c5,
    bool_or("st_cylinder/x_ext_on_off") AS c6,
    bool_or("st_cylinder/x_on_off") AS c7,
    bool_or("st_cylinder/x_running") AS c8,
    bool_or("x_cvlve") AS c9,
    bool_or("x_cyl_a") AS c10,
    bool_or("x_cyl_b") AS c11,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c12,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c13,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c14,
    bool_or("st_cylinder/x_function_enabled") AS c15,
    bool_or("st_cylinder/x_group_enabled") AS c16,
    bool_or("st_cylinder/x_local_control") AS c17,
    bool_or("st_cylinder/x_maintenance") AS c18,
    bool_or("st_cylinder/x_rc_control") AS c19,
    bool_or("st_cylinder/x_sensr_in") AS c20,
    bool_or("st_cylinder/x_sensr_out") AS c21,
    bool_or("st_load_lc/x_can_alive") AS c22,
    bool_or("st_position/x_can_alive") AS c23,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c24,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c25,
    bool_or("x_sensr_in") AS c26,
    bool_or("x_sensr_out") AS c27
    FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "st_cylinder/x_in", "st_cylinder/x_out", "x_in", "x_out", "st_cylinder/x_cyl_a", "st_cylinder/x_cyl_b", "st_cylinder/x_ext_on_off", "st_cylinder/x_on_off", "st_cylinder/x_running", "x_cvlve", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_cylinder/x_function_enabled", "st_cylinder/x_group_enabled", "st_cylinder/x_local_control", "st_cylinder/x_maintenance", "st_cylinder/x_rc_control", "st_cylinder/x_sensr_in", "st_cylinder/x_sensr_out", "st_load_lc/x_can_alive", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "st_cylinder/x_in", "st_cylinder/x_out", "x_in", "x_out", "st_cylinder/x_cyl_a", "st_cylinder/x_cyl_b", "st_cylinder/x_ext_on_off", "st_cylinder/x_on_off", "st_cylinder/x_running", "x_cvlve", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_cylinder/x_function_enabled", "st_cylinder/x_group_enabled", "st_cylinder/x_local_control", "st_cylinder/x_maintenance", "st_cylinder/x_rc_control", "st_cylinder/x_sensr_in", "st_cylinder/x_sensr_out", "st_load_lc/x_can_alive", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0204_main_boom_preventer WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "st_cylinder/x_in", "st_cylinder/x_out", "x_in", "x_out", "st_cylinder/x_cyl_a", "st_cylinder/x_cyl_b", "st_cylinder/x_ext_on_off", "st_cylinder/x_on_off", "st_cylinder/x_running", "x_cvlve", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_cylinder/x_function_enabled", "st_cylinder/x_group_enabled", "st_cylinder/x_local_control", "st_cylinder/x_maintenance", "st_cylinder/x_rc_control", "st_cylinder/x_sensr_in", "st_cylinder/x_sensr_out", "st_load_lc/x_can_alive", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0204_main_boom_preventer WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR (c13 IS DISTINCT FROM p13) OR (c14 IS DISTINCT FROM p14) OR (c15 IS DISTINCT FROM p15) OR (c16 IS DISTINCT FROM p16) OR (c17 IS DISTINCT FROM p17) OR (c18 IS DISTINCT FROM p18) OR (c19 IS DISTINCT FROM p19) OR (c20 IS DISTINCT FROM p20) OR (c21 IS DISTINCT FROM p21) OR (c22 IS DISTINCT FROM p22) OR (c23 IS DISTINCT FROM p23) OR (c24 IS DISTINCT FROM p24) OR (c25 IS DISTINCT FROM p25) OR (c26 IS DISTINCT FROM p26) OR (c27 IS DISTINCT FROM p27)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Alarms
panels.description: Red: alarm active. CAN state: off, ok or fault. Alarm codes as numbers, 0 = none.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "ox_gnrl_alrm", c1 AS "ox_load_alarm", c2 AS "st_cylinder/ox_gnrl_alrm", c3 AS "st_load/x_failure", c4 AS "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", c5 AS "st_load_lc/x_can_missing", c6 AS "st_load_lc/x_failure", c7 AS "st_load_lc/x_max_limit_reached", c8 AS "st_position/x_can_missing", c9 AS "st_position/x_failure", c10 AS "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", c11 AS "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", c12 AS "st_load_lc/w_can_state", c13 AS "st_position/w_can_state" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13 FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    bool_or("ox_gnrl_alrm") AS c0,
    bool_or("ox_load_alarm") AS c1,
    bool_or("st_cylinder/ox_gnrl_alrm") AS c2,
    bool_or("st_load/x_failure") AS c3,
    bool_or("st_load/x_max_limit_reached") AS c4,
    bool_or("st_load_lc/x_can_missing") AS c5,
    bool_or("st_load_lc/x_failure") AS c6,
    bool_or("st_load_lc/x_max_limit_reached") AS c7,
    bool_or("st_position/x_can_missing") AS c8,
    bool_or("st_position/x_failure") AS c9,
    bool_or("st_position/x_max_limit_reached") AS c10,
    bool_or("st_position/x_min_limit_reached") AS c11,
    CASE max("st_load_lc/w_can_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'CAN off' WHEN 1 THEN 'CAN ok' WHEN 2 THEN 'CAN fault' ELSE CAST(max("st_load_lc/w_can_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c12,
    CASE max("st_position/w_can_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'CAN off' WHEN 1 THEN 'CAN ok' WHEN 2 THEN 'CAN fault' ELSE CAST(max("st_position/w_can_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c13
    FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "st_cylinder/ox_gnrl_alrm", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "st_load_lc/x_can_missing", "st_load_lc/x_failure", "st_load_lc/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_can_missing", "st_position/x_failure", "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", "st_load_lc/w_can_state", "st_position/w_can_state" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "st_cylinder/ox_gnrl_alrm", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "st_load_lc/x_can_missing", "st_load_lc/x_failure", "st_load_lc/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_can_missing", "st_position/x_failure", "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", "st_load_lc/w_can_state", "st_position/w_can_state" FROM sail_systems__f0204_main_boom_preventer WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "st_cylinder/ox_gnrl_alrm", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "st_load_lc/x_can_missing", "st_load_lc/x_failure", "st_load_lc/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_can_missing", "st_position/x_failure", "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", "st_load_lc/w_can_state", "st_position/w_can_state" FROM sail_systems__f0204_main_boom_preventer WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR (c13 IS DISTINCT FROM p13)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Configuration
panels.description: Each PLC setting at the start and end of the range, and its min and max in it; min and max differ when it changed. Raw PLC units (loads in daN, positions in mm).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT unnest(make_array('i_feed_forward_pressure_setting', 'st_cylinder/i_feed_forward_pressure_setting', 'st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a', 'st_load/i_load_change_perm_a', 'st_load/i_max_load_setting', 'st_load_lc/i_max_load_setting', 'st_position/i_cylinder_length', 'st_position/i_max_position', 'st_position/i_min_position')) AS setting,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."i_feed_forward_pressure_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_cylinder/i_feed_forward_pressure_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_load_change_perm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load_lc/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_position/i_cylinder_length" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_position/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_position/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."i_feed_forward_pressure_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_cylinder/i_feed_forward_pressure_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_load_change_perm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load_lc/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_position/i_cylinder_length" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_position/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_position/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n6 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n7 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n8 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x6 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x7 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x8 AS DOUBLE))) AS max
FROM (SELECT "i_feed_forward_pressure_setting", "st_cylinder/i_feed_forward_pressure_setting", "st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a", "st_load/i_load_change_perm_a", "st_load/i_max_load_setting", "st_load_lc/i_max_load_setting", "st_position/i_cylinder_length", "st_position/i_max_position", "st_position/i_min_position" FROM sail_systems__f0204_main_boom_preventer WHERE timestamp <= $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) s
FULL JOIN (SELECT "i_feed_forward_pressure_setting", "st_cylinder/i_feed_forward_pressure_setting", "st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a", "st_load/i_load_change_perm_a", "st_load/i_max_load_setting", "st_load_lc/i_max_load_setting", "st_position/i_cylinder_length", "st_position/i_max_position", "st_position/i_min_position" FROM sail_systems__f0204_main_boom_preventer WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true
CROSS JOIN (SELECT min("i_feed_forward_pressure_setting") AS n0, max("i_feed_forward_pressure_setting") AS x0, min("st_cylinder/i_feed_forward_pressure_setting") AS n1, max("st_cylinder/i_feed_forward_pressure_setting") AS x1, min("st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a") AS n2, max("st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a") AS x2, min("st_load/i_load_change_perm_a") AS n3, max("st_load/i_load_change_perm_a") AS x3, min("st_load/i_max_load_setting") AS n4, max("st_load/i_max_load_setting") AS x4, min("st_load_lc/i_max_load_setting") AS n5, max("st_load_lc/i_max_load_setting") AS x5, min("st_position/i_cylinder_length") AS n6, max("st_position/i_cylinder_length") AS x6, min("st_position/i_max_position") AS n7, max("st_position/i_max_position") AS x7, min("st_position/i_min_position") AS n8, max("st_position/i_min_position") AS x8 FROM sail_systems__f0204_main_boom_preventer WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) r

panels.title: Line length
panels.description: Line or chain length in cm.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg("i_actual_line_length") AS "i_actual_line_length"
FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_actual_line_length" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_actual_line_length" FROM sail_systems__fe205_main_sheet_captive_winch WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_actual_line_length" FROM sail_systems__fe205_main_sheet_captive_winch WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) s
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Configuration
panels.description: Each PLC setting at the start and end of the range, and its min and max in it; min and max differ when it changed. Raw PLC units (loads in daN, positions in mm).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT unnest(make_array('i_min_vang_position', 'i_set_actual_line_length', 's_settings/i_ease_btn_speed', 's_settings/i_ease_max_speed', 's_settings/i_line_tension_delay', 's_settings/i_max_position', 's_settings/i_min_position', 's_settings/i_pull_btn_speed', 's_settings/i_pull_max_speed', 'st_load/i_max_load_setting')) AS setting,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."i_min_vang_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."i_set_actual_line_length" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_ease_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_line_tension_delay" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_pull_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."i_min_vang_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."i_set_actual_line_length" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_ease_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_line_tension_delay" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_pull_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n6 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n7 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n8 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n9 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x6 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x7 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x8 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x9 AS DOUBLE))) AS max
FROM (SELECT "i_min_vang_position", "i_set_actual_line_length", "s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed", "s_settings/i_ease_max_speed", "s_settings/i_line_tension_delay", "s_settings/i_max_position", "s_settings/i_min_position", "s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed", "s_settings/i_pull_max_speed", "st_load/i_max_load_setting" FROM sail_systems__fe205_main_sheet_captive_winch WHERE timestamp <= $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) s
FULL JOIN (SELECT "i_min_vang_position", "i_set_actual_line_length", "s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed", "s_settings/i_ease_max_speed", "s_settings/i_line_tension_delay", "s_settings/i_max_position", "s_settings/i_min_position", "s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed", "s_settings/i_pull_max_speed", "st_load/i_max_load_setting" FROM sail_systems__fe205_main_sheet_captive_winch WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true
CROSS JOIN (SELECT min("i_min_vang_position") AS n0, max("i_min_vang_position") AS x0, min("i_set_actual_line_length") AS n1, max("i_set_actual_line_length") AS x1, min("s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed") AS n2, max("s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed") AS x2, min("s_settings/i_ease_max_speed") AS n3, max("s_settings/i_ease_max_speed") AS x3, min("s_settings/i_line_tension_delay") AS n4, max("s_settings/i_line_tension_delay") AS x4, min("s_settings/i_max_position") AS n5, max("s_settings/i_max_position") AS x5, min("s_settings/i_min_position") AS n6, max("s_settings/i_min_position") AS x6, min("s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed") AS n7, max("s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed") AS x7, min("s_settings/i_pull_max_speed") AS n8, max("s_settings/i_pull_max_speed") AS x8, min("st_load/i_max_load_setting") AS n9, max("st_load/i_max_load_setting") AS x9 FROM sail_systems__fe205_main_sheet_captive_winch WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) r

SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "x_pull/ease", c3 AS "s_drive_a/x_running", c4 AS "s_drive_b/x_running", c5 AS "x_ext_on_off", c6 AS "x_on_off", c7 AS "x_running", c8 AS "s_drive_a/x_brake", c9 AS "s_drive_a/x_can_alive", c10 AS "s_drive_a/x_ready", c11 AS "s_drive_a/x_run", c12 AS "s_drive_b/x_brake", c13 AS "s_drive_b/x_can_alive", c14 AS "s_drive_b/x_ready", c15 AS "s_drive_b/x_run", c16 AS "s_supply_a/x_can_alive", c17 AS "s_supply_a/x_power_on", c18 AS "s_supply_b/x_can_alive", c19 AS "s_supply_b/x_power_on", c20 AS "s_supply_c/x_can_alive", c21 AS "s_supply_c/x_power_on", c22 AS "x_function_enabled", c23 AS "x_group_enabled", c24 AS "x_running_ccw", c25 AS "x_running_cw" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, c15, c16, c17, c18, c19, c20, c21, c22, c23, c24, c25, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LAG(c14) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p14, LAG(c15) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p15, LAG(c16) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p16, LAG(c17) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p17, LAG(c18) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p18, LAG(c19) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p19, LAG(c20) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p20, LAG(c21) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p21, LAG(c22) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p22, LAG(c23) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p23, LAG(c24) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p24, LAG(c25) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p25 FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_pull") AND bool_or("x_ease") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("x_pull") THEN 'pull' WHEN bool_or("x_ease") THEN 'ease' WHEN count("x_pull") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    bool_or("s_drive_a/x_running") AS c3,
    bool_or("s_drive_b/x_running") AS c4,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c5,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c7,
    bool_or("s_drive_a/x_brake") AS c8,
    bool_or("s_drive_a/x_can_alive") AS c9,
    bool_or("s_drive_a/x_ready") AS c10,
    bool_or("s_drive_a/x_run") AS c11,
    bool_or("s_drive_b/x_brake") AS c12,
    bool_or("s_drive_b/x_can_alive") AS c13,
    bool_or("s_drive_b/x_ready") AS c14,
    bool_or("s_drive_b/x_run") AS c15,
    bool_or("s_supply_a/x_can_alive") AS c16,
    bool_or("s_supply_a/x_power_on") AS c17,
    bool_or("s_supply_b/x_can_alive") AS c18,
    bool_or("s_supply_b/x_power_on") AS c19,
    bool_or("s_supply_c/x_can_alive") AS c20,
    bool_or("s_supply_c/x_power_on") AS c21,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c22,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c23,

  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, c15, c16, c17, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LAG(c14) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p14, LAG(c15) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p15, LAG(c16) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p16, LAG(c17) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p17 FROM (

    CASE max("s_supply_a/w_can_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'CAN off' WHEN 1 THEN 'CAN ok' WHEN 2 THEN 'CAN fault' ELSE CAST(max("s_supply_a/w_can_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c12,
    CASE max("s_supply_b/w_can_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'CAN off' WHEN 1 THEN 'CAN ok' WHEN 2 THEN 'CAN fault' ELSE CAST(max("s_supply_b/w_can_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c13,
    CASE max("s_supply_c/w_can_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'CAN off' WHEN 1 THEN 'CAN ok' WHEN 2 THEN 'CAN fault' ELSE CAST(max("s_supply_c/w_can_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c14,

  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "s_drive_a/x_can_missing", "s_drive_a/x_fault", "s_drive_b/x_can_missing", "s_drive_b/x_fault", "s_supply_a/x_can_missing", "s_supply_b/x_can_missing", "s_supply_c/x_can_missing", "x_drive_not_running_alarm", "x_speed_deviation_alarm", "s_drive_a/w_can_state", "s_drive_b/w_can_state", "s_supply_a/w_can_state", "s_supply_b/w_can_state", "s_supply_c/w_can_state", "s_drive_a/w_active_fault", "s_drive_b/w_active_fault", "w_active_fault" FROM sail_systems__fe206_main_sheet_feeder WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR (c13 IS DISTINCT FROM p13) OR (c14 IS DISTINCT FROM p14) OR (c15 IS DISTINCT FROM p15) OR (c16 IS DISTINCT FROM p16) OR (c17 IS DISTINCT FROM p17)

panels.title: Configuration
panels.description: Each PLC setting at the start and end of the range, and its min and max in it; min and max differ when it changed. Raw PLC units (loads in daN, positions in mm).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT unnest(make_array('r_ease_torque_setting', 'r_pull_torque_setting')) AS setting,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."r_ease_torque_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."r_pull_torque_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."r_ease_torque_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."r_pull_torque_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE))) AS max
FROM (SELECT "r_ease_torque_setting", "r_pull_torque_setting" FROM sail_systems__fe206_main_sheet_feeder WHERE timestamp <= $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) s
FULL JOIN (SELECT "r_ease_torque_setting", "r_pull_torque_setting" FROM sail_systems__fe206_main_sheet_feeder WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true
CROSS JOIN (SELECT min("r_ease_torque_setting") AS n0, max("r_ease_torque_setting") AS x0, min("r_pull_torque_setting") AS n1, max("r_pull_torque_setting") AS x1 FROM sail_systems__fe206_main_sheet_feeder WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) r

panels.description: Blue: command or PLC output (ox_) on, green: status true. Opposite commands such as pull/ease share a lane. x_on_off: HMI toggle, x_ext_on_off: AMCS toggle.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "ix_btn_pull/ease", c3 AS "ox_pull/ease", c4 AS "ix_mnl_ctrl", c5 AS "ox_pwr_enable", c6 AS "s_drive/x_running", c7 AS "x_ext_on_off", c8 AS "x_on_off", c9 AS "x_oo_c", c10 AS "x_running", c11 AS "ix_relay_status", c12 AS "ix_snsr_dti", c13 AS "ix_snsr_in", c14 AS "ix_snsr_line", c15 AS "ix_snsr_out", c16 AS "s_drive/x_can_alive", c17 AS "s_drive/x_ready", c18 AS "x_activate_line_length_setting", c19 AS "x_function_enabled", c20 AS "x_group_enabled", c21 AS "x_inner_limit", c22 AS "x_outer_limit" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, c15, c16, c17, c18, c19, c20, c21, c22, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LAG(c14) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p14, LAG(c15) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p15, LAG(c16) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p16, LAG(c17) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p17, LAG(c18) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p18, LAG(c19) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p19, LAG(c20) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p20, LAG(c21) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p21, LAG(c22) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p22 FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_pull") AND bool_or("ix_btn_ease") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_pull") THEN 'pull' WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_ease") THEN 'ease' WHEN count("ix_btn_pull") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ox_pull") AND bool_or("ox_ease") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ox_pull") THEN 'pull' WHEN bool_or("ox_ease") THEN 'ease' WHEN count("ox_pull") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c3,
    bool_or("ix_mnl_ctrl") AS c4,
    bool_or("ox_pwr_enable") AS c5,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_running") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c7,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c8,
    bool_or("x_oo_c") AS c9,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c10,
    bool_or("ix_relay_status") AS c11,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_dti") AS c12,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_in") AS c13,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_line") AS c14,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_out") AS c15,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_alive") AS c16,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_ready") AS c17,
    bool_or("x_activate_line_length_setting") AS c18,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c19,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c20,
    bool_or("x_inner_limit") AS c21,
    bool_or("x_outer_limit") AS c22
    FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM sail_systems__fe207_main_halyard_captive_winch WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM sail_systems__fe207_main_halyard_captive_winch WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) s
    GROUP BY 1

    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,

panels.title: Commands and status

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "ix_btn_pull/ease", c3 AS "ox_pull/ease", c4 AS "ix_mnl_ctrl", c5 AS "ox_pwr_enable", c6 AS "s_drive/x_running", c7 AS "x_ext_on_off", c8 AS "x_on_off", c9 AS "x_oo_c", c10 AS "x_running", c11 AS "ix_relay_status", c12 AS "ix_snsr_dti", c13 AS "ix_snsr_in", c14 AS "ix_snsr_line", c15 AS "ix_snsr_out", c16 AS "s_drive/x_can_alive", c17 AS "s_drive/x_ready", c18 AS "st_load/x_can_alive", c19 AS "x_activate_line_length_setting", c20 AS "x_function_enabled", c21 AS "x_group_enabled", c22 AS "x_inner_limit", c23 AS "x_outer_limit" FROM (

    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_pull") AND bool_or("ix_btn_ease") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_pull") THEN 'pull' WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_ease") THEN 'ease' WHEN count("ix_btn_pull") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,

    bool_or("ix_snsr_line") AS c14,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_out") AS c15,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_alive") AS c16,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_ready") AS c17,
    bool_or("st_load/x_can_alive") AS c18,
    bool_or("x_activate_line_length_setting") AS c19,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c20,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c21,
    bool_or("x_inner_limit") AS c22,
    bool_or("x_outer_limit") AS c23
    FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "st_load/x_can_alive", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "st_load/x_can_alive", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM sail_systems__fe501_main_runner_captive_winch_sb WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "st_load/x_can_alive", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM sail_systems__fe501_main_runner_captive_winch_sb WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b

    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR (c13 IS DISTINCT FROM p13)

  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "s_drive_a/x_can_missing", "s_drive_a/x_fault", "s_drive_b/x_can_missing", "s_drive_b/x_fault", "s_supply_a/x_can_missing", "s_supply_b/x_can_missing", "s_supply_c/x_can_missing", "x_drive_not_running_alarm", "x_speed_deviation_alarm", "s_drive_a/w_can_state", "s_drive_b/w_can_state", "s_supply_a/w_can_state", "s_supply_b/w_can_state", "s_supply_c/w_can_state", "s_drive_a/w_active_fault", "s_drive_b/w_active_fault", "w_active_fault" FROM sail_systems__fe505_mizzen_sheet_feeder WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR (c13 IS DISTINCT FROM p13) OR (c14 IS DISTINCT FROM p14) OR (c15 IS DISTINCT FROM p15) OR (c16 IS DISTINCT FROM p16) OR (c17 IS DISTINCT FROM p17)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "ix_btn_pull/ease", c3 AS "ox_pull/ease", c4 AS "ix_mnl_ctrl", c5 AS "ox_pwr_enable", c6 AS "s_drive/x_running", c7 AS "x_ext_on_off", c8 AS "x_on_off", c9 AS "x_oo_c", c10 AS "x_running", c11 AS "ix_relay_status", c12 AS "ix_snsr_dti", c13 AS "ix_snsr_in", c14 AS "ix_snsr_line", c15 AS "ix_snsr_out", c16 AS "s_drive/x_can_alive", c17 AS "s_drive/x_ready", c18 AS "x_activate_line_length_setting", c19 AS "x_function_enabled", c20 AS "x_group_enabled", c21 AS "x_inner_limit", c22 AS "x_outer_limit" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, c15, c16, c17, c18, c19, c20, c21, c22, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LAG(c14) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p14, LAG(c15) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p15, LAG(c16) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p16, LAG(c17) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p17, LAG(c18) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p18, LAG(c19) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p19, LAG(c20) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p20, LAG(c21) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p21, LAG(c22) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p22 FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_pull") AND bool_or("ix_btn_ease") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_pull") THEN 'pull' WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_ease") THEN 'ease' WHEN count("ix_btn_pull") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ox_pull") AND bool_or("ox_ease") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ox_pull") THEN 'pull' WHEN bool_or("ox_ease") THEN 'ease' WHEN count("ox_pull") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c3,
    bool_or("ix_mnl_ctrl") AS c4,
    bool_or("ox_pwr_enable") AS c5,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_running") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c7,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c8,
    bool_or("x_oo_c") AS c9,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c10,
    bool_or("ix_relay_status") AS c11,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_dti") AS c12,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_in") AS c13,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_line") AS c14,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_out") AS c15,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_alive") AS c16,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_ready") AS c17,
    bool_or("x_activate_line_length_setting") AS c18,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c19,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c20,
    bool_or("x_inner_limit") AS c21,

SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "ix_btn_pull/ease", c3 AS "ox_pull/ease", c4 AS "ix_mnl_ctrl", c5 AS "ox_pwr_enable", c6 AS "s_drive/x_running", c7 AS "x_ext_on_off", c8 AS "x_on_off", c9 AS "x_oo_c", c10 AS "x_running", c11 AS "ix_relay_status", c12 AS "ix_snsr_dti", c13 AS "ix_snsr_in", c14 AS "ix_snsr_line", c15 AS "ix_snsr_out", c16 AS "s_drive/x_can_alive", c17 AS "s_drive/x_ready", c18 AS "st_load/x_can_alive", c19 AS "x_activate_line_length_setting", c20 AS "x_function_enabled", c21 AS "x_group_enabled", c22 AS "x_inner_limit", c23 AS "x_outer_limit" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, c15, c16, c17, c18, c19, c20, c21, c22, c23, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LAG(c14) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p14, LAG(c15) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p15, LAG(c16) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p16, LAG(c17) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p17, LAG(c18) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p18, LAG(c19) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p19, LAG(c20) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p20, LAG(c21) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p21, LAG(c22) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p22, LAG(c23) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p23 FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_pull") AND bool_or("ix_btn_ease") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_pull") THEN 'pull' WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_ease") THEN 'ease' WHEN count("ix_btn_pull") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ox_pull") AND bool_or("ox_ease") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ox_pull") THEN 'pull' WHEN bool_or("ox_ease") THEN 'ease' WHEN count("ox_pull") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c3,

    bool_or("ix_snsr_out") AS c15,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_alive") AS c16,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_ready") AS c17,
    bool_or("st_load/x_can_alive") AS c18,
    bool_or("x_activate_line_length_setting") AS c19,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c20,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c21,
    bool_or("x_inner_limit") AS c22,
    bool_or("x_outer_limit") AS c23
    FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "st_load/x_can_alive", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "st_load/x_can_alive", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM sail_systems__fe402_mizzen_runner_captive_winch_ps WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "st_load/x_can_alive", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM sail_systems__fe402_mizzen_runner_captive_winch_ps WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) s

  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."io_spd_stp_1" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."io_spd_stp_1_bw" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."io_spd_stp_2" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."io_spd_stp_3" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_load_at_0_v" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_load_change_per_v" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."io_spd_stp_1" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."io_spd_stp_1_bw" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."io_spd_stp_2" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."io_spd_stp_3" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_load_at_0_v" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_load_change_per_v" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n6 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,

CROSS JOIN (SELECT min("io_spd_stp_1") AS n0, max("io_spd_stp_1") AS x0, min("io_spd_stp_1_bw") AS n1, max("io_spd_stp_1_bw") AS x1, min("io_spd_stp_2") AS n2, max("io_spd_stp_2") AS x2, min("io_spd_stp_3") AS n3, max("io_spd_stp_3") AS x3, min("st_load/i_load_at_0_v") AS n4, max("st_load/i_load_at_0_v") AS x4, min("st_load/i_load_change_per_v") AS n5, max("st_load/i_load_change_per_v") AS x5, min("st_load/i_max_load_setting") AS n6, max("st_load/i_max_load_setting") AS x6 FROM sail_systems__fe308_primary_deck_winch_sb WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) r
